businesses.business: payment processing and financial technology services

offering_description.value: Provides merchant acquiring, payment processing, core banking and business process services to banks, merchants and governments, mainly in Puerto Rico and Latin America. Delivers through its own transaction-processing platforms, data centers and software.

primary_products.value: point-of-sale terminals; core banking software; payment processing platforms; electronic payment software

primary_services.value: merchant acquiring; payment processing; ATM and card processing; core banking processing; business process outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, merchants, financial institutions, corporations; B2G: Puerto Rico government agencies using payment and technology services

end_markets.value: banking and financial services; retail merchants; government; healthcare; utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per transaction processed for merchants and card issuers; service fees: outsourced processing, core banking and business process services; product sales: point-of-sale terminals and related equipment; licensing or royalties: software licenses and maintenance
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; product sales; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates payment and core banking platforms sold to banks and merchants; financial intermediary: merchant acquirer processing card payments between merchants and card networks; service provider: outsourced technology and processing services to banks and governments
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Puerto Rico, Caribbean, Central and South America, and some US operations

specialization.value: related lines: merchant acquiring, payment services and business solutions such as core banking, all payments-related

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to banks, merchants and government agencies; partners / resellers: bank partners and referral partners for merchant acquiring

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment processing subject to card network rules, PCI standards, banking regulators' oversight, data privacy and anti-money-laundering rules
